PhD Position (f/m/d): GPU-accelerated Matrix-free Solvers for CFD

The Chair of Numerical Methods in Exampleton offers a fully funded doctoral position (TV-L E13, 100 %).

You will develop matrix-free discontinuous Galerkin solvers for the Navier-Stokes equations on GPUs.

Application deadline: 15.12.2026
